execution.entry_reason: The declared entry TorchDevice.mha never calls SelfAttention.prefetch_cache (step 4 reports call_chain_status not_found). The witness also calls path an input, but the repository computes it as a local assigned only 0, 1, or 2; the natural path-0 arm returns before line 466. The driver calls the real target directly and supplies the witness path at the real target frame so the line-466 dispatch itself is exercised. No repository file is modified.
